answer_q: How do I validate and format JSON?
answer: Parse it with a strict JSON parser; if it parses, re-print it with indentation. Paste your JSON here and it is checked and formatted as you type, with the line and column of any error.

examples.title: A common error
examples.output: Invalid JSON. Look for a trailing comma before } or ].

faq.q: Why is my JSON invalid when it works in JavaScript?
faq.a: JSON is stricter than JavaScript: keys need double quotes, strings cannot use single quotes, and trailing commas and comments are not allowed.

faq.q: Does sorting keys change the data?
faq.a: No. Object key order has no meaning in JSON. Sorting just makes two files easier to compare.
